validity_notes: Frozen decision_rule Relaxed_substrate clause applies: 0 qualifying datasets => MEASUREMENT_INVALID substrate_insufficient. This is a substrate/data insufficiency, NOT a scientific negative: C-WEB-DYNAMICS was not tested for timescale or barrier structure and receives no claim update (remains HYPOTHESIS per codex/claim_state.json).

The frozen relaxed-sufficiency gate requires dom_bytes>=500 and a11y non-empty on >=80% of transitions. The only legitimate substrate available (reused TodoMVC raw trajectories) contains no DOM/a11y snapshots: the collector (collect_spa_survey.py of EXP-PHYSICS-35209110569) recorded url/title/action fields only. Coverage is 0.0% by field absence on all 5 variants.

The design's reuse assumption is therefore not satisfied: spec/prereg instructed 'preserve raw DOM/a11y bytes' and required dom_bytes coverage, but the referenced raw artifacts do not contain such bytes. This exact gap is the failure to report; the smallest unblocking actions are: re-collect TodoMVC/WebShop trajectories WITH visibleText + Accessibility.getFullAXTree snapshots, or obtain intel-supplied BrowserGym trajectories (research/intel/ is absent).

Substituting locally-hosted Express synthetics or Wikipedia/Python-docs MPAs for TodoMVC/WebShop is explicitly forbidden by the frozen spec and was not done; EXP-PHYSICS-33965269281 Wikipedia/Python-docs captures (link_texts, tag_counts, empty accessibility_roles) are MPAs and outside the frozen dataset list (max 6 = 5 TodoMVC + WebShop if found).

The timescale prong H_T is expressible on URL|title-derived S_primary state sequences from the reused files (S=sha256(norm(url_after)|norm(title_after))), but the frozen gate blocks primary testing at Q==0 ('do not test H_T/H_B'), and the mandatory B-DOM-SIMILARITY baseline requires DOM text for both R1/R2; a partial H_T run could not satisfy the frozen primary condition as written and would violate the frozen halt rule.

Leakage/normalization executed exactly per this experiment's frozen definitions (normalize URL: lowercase, strip query, preserve SPA hash fragment, strip trailing slash). The prior experiment's fragment-stripping normalization differs; per-dataset leakage counts differ only for angular (23 vs 37) and do not affect any gate outcome. Both interpretations are recorded.

Strata key (URL_before, H_K=3 actions, Action) uses primitive-only leakage-free actions because the reused raw files never recorded target_sig fields (role/name/testId/aria-label); href never enters A. Any retry with richer substrate must record full target_sig.

Execution environment lacks numpy/scipy/sklearn/playwright (Python 3.12.14 stdlib only). The gate path required stdlib only; the primary-stage pipeline (grouped permutation, Dirichlet-Multinomial BF, TF-IDF similarity, dip test) would require installing these, which is a further prerequisite for any retry on qualifying substrate.
No freeze-input file was modified after freeze; hash verification was performed before any computation. Determinism: PYTHONHASHSEED=0; gate path uses no RNG.
